text:
Talia: Final checklist for Wednesday 10am PT webinar 'Serving: benchmarks + cost playbook'. Need owners for reg page fields, Zoom settings, backup recording, upload path, and post-event cadence. Short thread please.

Jon: I can own Zoom + uploads. Plan: cloud recording (speaker + shared screen), enable audio transcript (VTT), local OBS backup on host laptop. Add co-host Pri so recording persists. Keep authentication OFF. After session I'll download cloud MP4 + VTT and upload to S3.

Pri: I'll ship the registration page and confirmation email. Required fields: email, company, job_title. Hidden fields: utm_source, utm_campaign. Form GUID will be posted after staging publish. Tagging: webinar_costplay_0929. Also including calendar invite with two CTAs: "Watch replay" and "Book demo".

Marco: Editing + shorts. Deliverables: 1x 90s highlight, 3x 30s social cuts (one vertical), captions SRT, and plain transcript .txt. Naming pref: CP0929_raw_cloud.mp4, CP0929_transcript.txt. Need raw files within 2 hours.

Jon: Upload steps (post-event): 1) Download Zoom MP4 + VTT 2) Copy local OBS MP4 if present 3) Upload to s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-09-29-cost-play/raw/ with ACL marketing-editors 4) create Drive folder for editors and post link. Quick CLI if useful:
```
aws s3 cp "CP0929_raw_cloud.mp4" "s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-09-29-cost-play/raw/CP0929_raw_cloud.mp4" --acl bucket-owner-full-control
aws s3 cp "CP0929_transcript.vtt" "s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-09-29-cost-play/raw/CP0929_transcript.vtt"
```

ZoomBot: Recording started by host Jon at 10:01 AM PT.

Talia: Post-event cadence proposal: 1h after -> private replay email (short summary + 7-day signed link + scheduler CTA); 24h -> highlights + clips email; 48h -> full edited recording + transcript + blog summary; 72h -> asset library + SDR handoff for MQLs.

Pri: HubSpot mapping for ops (draft): hs_form_guid: b7d9c1a2; fields: [email, firstname, lastname, company, job_title, utm_source, utm_campaign]; lead_routing: assign_to_queue(webinar_ops); contact_tag: webinar_costplay_0929. I'll paste webhook URL in-thread once Ops confirms endpoint.

Marco: For edits please include timestamps.txt with clip ranges and speaker labels. I'll convert VTT -> SRT and export both 16:9 and 9:16 masters.

Jon: I will upload raw files within 90 minutes and post S3 + Drive links here. If cloud recording fails, we'll use local OBS backup and name it CP0929_raw_local.mp4.

Talia: Owners recap: Reg page + tracking = Pri; Zoom + uploads = Jon; Clips & edits = Marco; Cadence + replay copy = Talia. Deadline: raw files uploaded and Drive link posted within 90 minutes; first clip drafts in 36 hours. Thanks all :rocket:

ZoomBot: Recording ended at 11:07 AM PT. Cloud recording available: https://zoom.us/rec/share/EXAMPLE_CP0929 (access restricted).
